* No class

* Assign
* Add class
* Update LA duration

cases.title: User changes location course + class of a LA a active class
cases.preconditions:

* User has created a lesson allocation with type = Regular or Seasonal with LC A and Class A

steps.action: * Change to location course B + Class B

cases.title: [Renseikai] Configure Alert – Partner Config Flag – Out of Duration config disabled – Alert flag recognized by system
cases.description: AC 01.1 — Decision Table — When the "Out of Duration Students" alert config flag is set to disabled for the Renseikai partner, the system recognizes and applies the config.
cases.preconditions:
- Logged in as Renseikai Admin or CM user
- The Renseikai partner has the `show_out_of_duration_alert` config flag set to `FALSE`
- A lesson exists at a Renseikai location with at least one student whose lesson date falls outside their course LA duration

steps.action: Open the SF Lesson detail page for the lesson with out-of-duration student
steps.expected_result: SF Lesson detail page loads
steps.data: Lesson with 1 student outside LA duration

steps.action: Navigate to the Participants tab → Student Sessions section
steps.expected_result: Student Sessions section is displayed

steps.action: Observe the alert banners area
steps.expected_result: The "⚠ Lesson falls outside this student's course duration." banner is not visible

steps.action: Open the BO Lesson detail page for the same lesson
steps.expected_result: BO Lesson detail page loads

steps.action: Observe the alert banners area on BO
steps.expected_result: The out-of-duration alert banner is not visible on BO either

steps.action: Observe the alert banners area

steps.action: Open the BO Lesson detail page for the same lesson
steps.expected_result: BO Lesson detail page loads

steps.action: Observe the alert banners area on BO
steps.expected_result: The classroom capacity alert banner is not visible on BO either

steps.text: Parent/Student logins to the Learner app
Parent/Student goes to the Calendar tab
Parent/Student clicks on a Submit Attendance button
Student/Parent sees the Submit Attendance form with following info:
Start date: The date user has selected on the calendar before clicking "Submit Attendance" button
End date: selected date + 7
If the selected date is a past date, the default of the start date is today.
Lesson list: show all lesson items of the student with Published/Completed status at selected dates with lesson_end_date >= today
Lesson item:
+ Lesson name
+ Date&time
+ Attendance Response
Next button is enable when selecting the lesson

steps.text: Parent/Student clicks on the Next button
Student/Parent sees the Submit Attendance form with following info:
Lesson selected: number of lesson
Date
+ If start date = end date: display only Start Date
+ If start date <> end date: display Start date - End date
Attendance option: Absent, Late, Leave Early
Reason: optional field

cases.title: [A05] Get Courses Master Data API includes Interview Flag and Subject Master

cases.title: Assign student to existing Activity Event from Contact page
cases.description: Ensure staff can assign a student to an existing Activity Event using the Add button on the Contact page.
cases.preconditions: User is on the Event Master page with create permission.

steps.text: a staff user is on a Student's Contact page
they click the 'Add' button under the Event History tab
select an Event Master that matches the student's segment
select an Activity Event from the filtered list
the student should be added to the selected Activity Event
the event should be listed under the Event History tab

cases.title: Edit Activity Event and update Interview Type
cases.description: Ensure user can edit and update Interview Type in an existing event.
cases.preconditions: Activity Event exists with Conference = true.

steps.text: a staff user opens an Activity Event with Conference checked
they edit the Interview Type field
click Save
the updated Interview Type should be saved and displayed

cases.title: Delete Activity Event from Event Master
cases.description: Ensure user can delete an Activity Event from Event Master page.
cases.preconditions: An Activity Event is listed under an Event Master.

steps.text: a staff user is on the Event Master page
they click delete on an Activity Event
confirm the deletion
the event should be removed from the list

cases.title: Validation when saving Activity Event without required fields
cases.description: Verify required fields validation is triggered on empty fields.
cases.preconditions: User is on Activity Event creation form.

steps.text: a staff user is creating an Activity Event
they leave required fields empty
click Save
error messages should be displayed for each missing field

cases.title: Validation when Conference is checked but Interview Type is not selected
cases.description: Interview Type should be required only when Conference is checked.
cases.preconditions: User opens Activity Event creation and checks Conference.

steps.text: a staff user checks the Conference box
they try to save without selecting Interview Type
an error should be shown requiring Interview Type

cases.title: Prevent duplicate Activity Event creation
cases.description: Verify system blocks duplicate entries.
cases.preconditions: An Activity Event with same name/date exists.

steps.text: an Activity Event already exists
staff tries to create a new one with identical name/date
a duplicate error should be shown

cases.title: Create Activity Event with max length in description
cases.description: Ensure system handles max character limit in description field.
cases.preconditions: User is on Activity Event form.

steps.text: a user fills the description field with 500 characters
they save the form
the event should be created successfully
the description should be fully stored

cases.title: Restrict Activity Event editing to authorized roles
cases.description: Ensure that only users with permission can edit Activity Events.
cases.preconditions: User is logged in with limited role.

steps.text: a user without edit permissions
they open an Activity Event
the fields should be read-only
the Save button should be disabled

cases.title: Prevent unauthorized bulk uploads
cases.description: Only authorized staff should be able to upload bulk assignment files.
cases.preconditions: User role does not include upload permission.

steps.text: a user without upload rights accesses Activity Event page
they try to upload a CSV file
an access denied message should be shown

cases.title: Display Event Description in Event List
cases.description: Verify Event Description is visible in Event History tab list.
cases.preconditions: Activity Event has description.

steps.text: a student is assigned to an Activity Event with a description
viewing Event History tab
the description should appear after End Date Time

cases.title: Check localization of Activity Event fields
cases.description: Ensure UI displays labels correctly in Japanese (Withus customization).
cases.preconditions: System locale set to Japanese.

steps.text: a user opens the Activity Event form
they view all custom fields
the labels should appear in Japanese as configured

cases.title: Upload large CSV file for bulk assignment
cases.description: Ensure system can handle bulk assignment via CSV with >1000 students.
cases.preconditions: CSV file with 1000+ rows prepared.

steps.text: a staff user uploads a CSV file with 1000+ students
they confirm the import
all students should be assigned within acceptable time

cases.title: Reassign student to another Activity Event
cases.description: Ensure reassigning a student does not duplicate or break data.
cases.preconditions: Student is already assigned to one Activity Event.

steps.text: a student is assigned to an Activity Event
staff reassigns them to a different Activity Event
the new assignment should replace the old one

cases.title: Event creation updates Participant list
cases.description: Ensure that saving an event updates participant list backend.
cases.preconditions: Student added via UI flow.

steps.text: a student is assigned to an Activity Event
the event is saved
the backend Participant record should reflect the assignment

cases.title: Recover after failed Activity Event submission
cases.description: Ensure form state is retained after a failed submit attempt.
cases.preconditions: User has filled form but triggered a validation error.

steps.text: a user fills most of the Activity Event form
they forget a required field and click Save
an error shows
all previously entered values should remain on the form

suites.title: [Renseikai] Class Name Unique check via CSV import
suites.description: [https://manabie.atlassian.net/browse/LT-93059](https://manabie.atlassian.net/browse/LT-93059)

cases.title: CSV import succeeds when all Class Names are unique within the same Location Course
cases.description: Verify that the import process completes successfully when no duplicate Class Names exist within any single Location Course.
cases.preconditions: HQ staff user is logged in and has access to the CSV import feature. Target Location Courses exist in the system.

steps.action: Prepare a CSV file containing multiple Class records mapped to one Location Course, each with a distinct Class Name.
steps.expected_result: CSV file is ready and contains no duplicate Class Names for LocationCourse=A.

steps.action: Start the CSV import process and upload the prepared CSV file.
steps.expected_result: System accepts the file and begins validation/import without showing duplicate-name errors.

steps.action: Complete the import and review the import summary/results.
steps.expected_result: Import completes successfully; all classes are created/updated as expected; no errors related to Class Name uniqueness are shown.

steps.action: Navigate to the Location Course and verify the created classes.
steps.expected_result: All classes appear under the Location Course with the exact Class Names from the CSV and no unintended modifications.

cases.title: CSV import shows error when two rows in the same file have duplicate Class Names for the same Location Course
cases.description: Validate that the import detects duplicates within the same Location Course in the uploaded CSV and displays an error consistent with UI validation behavior.
cases.preconditions: HQ staff user is logged in. LocationCourse=A exists. No special classes required beforehand.

steps.action: Prepare a CSV file with two rows that have the same Class Name and the same Location Course.
steps.expected_result: CSV file contains a duplicate Class Name within LocationCourse=A.

steps.action: Upload the CSV file via the import process.
steps.expected_result: System performs validation and flags the duplicate Class Name for the same Location Course.

steps.action: Review the error output in the import UI (inline errors, summary, or downloadable error report).
steps.expected_result: An error is displayed indicating duplicate Class Name within the same Location Course; the error is clearly associated with the offending row(s).

steps.action: Confirm that no partial/incorrect class records were created for the duplicate entries.
steps.expected_result: System does not create conflicting duplicates; behavior matches the defined import rules (e.g., import blocked or only valid rows processed) while preserving data integrity.

cases.title: CSV import allows same Class Name across different Location Courses
cases.description: Ensure uniqueness is enforced only within the same Location Course and not globally across all Location Courses.
cases.preconditions: HQ staff user is logged in. LocationCourse=A and LocationCourse=B exist.

steps.action: Prepare a CSV file with the same Class Name used in two different Location Courses.
steps.expected_result: CSV file contains identical Class Names but in different Location Courses.

steps.action: Upload and run the CSV import.
steps.expected_result: Validation passes for uniqueness because duplicates are not within the same Location Course.

steps.action: Verify the import results and created/updated records.
steps.expected_result: Both classes exist, each under its respective Location Course, with the same Class Name and no uniqueness error.

cases.title: CSV import shows error when Class Name duplicates an existing class in the same Location Course
cases.description: Verify that import validation checks against existing system data and blocks/flags duplicates within the same Location Course.
cases.preconditions: HQ staff user is logged in. LocationCourse=A exists. A class with ClassName=Alpha already exists under LocationCourse=A.

steps.action: Confirm existing data includes a class named Alpha in LocationCourse=A.
steps.expected_result: Existing class Alpha is present under LocationCourse=A.

steps.action: Prepare a CSV file that attempts to create a new class with the same Class Name in the same Location Course.
steps.expected_result: CSV file would create a duplicate Class Name within LocationCourse=A.

steps.action: Upload the CSV file and run import validation.
steps.expected_result: System displays an error for duplicate Class Name in the same Location Course, consistent with UI behavior.

steps.action: Verify that no additional duplicate class record is created.
steps.expected_result: Only the original class exists; no duplicate record is added.

cases.title: CSV import allows Class Name that exists in a different Location Course (existing data)
cases.description: Ensure import does not incorrectly block Class Names that are duplicates only across different Location Courses.
cases.preconditions: HQ staff user is logged in. LocationCourse=A and LocationCourse=B exist. A class with ClassName=Alpha exists under LocationCourse=A.

steps.action: Confirm existing class Alpha exists under LocationCourse=A.
steps.expected_result: Existing class Alpha is present under LocationCourse=A.

steps.action: Prepare a CSV file to create a class named Alpha under LocationCourse=B.
steps.expected_result: CSV file uses a Class Name that exists elsewhere but not within LocationCourse=B.

steps.action: Upload and run the CSV import.
steps.expected_result: Import validation passes for uniqueness; no duplicate error is shown.

steps.action: Verify the class is created under LocationCourse=B.
steps.expected_result: Class Alpha exists under LocationCourse=B; existing class under LocationCourse=A remains unchanged.

cases.title: CSV import reports duplicates per Location Course independently when same Class Name appears in multiple Location Courses with internal duplicates
cases.description: Verify that duplicate detection is scoped per Location Course and errors are reported for each affected Location Course without false positives across courses.
cases.preconditions: HQ staff user is logged in. LocationCourse=A and LocationCourse=B exist.

steps.action: Prepare a CSV where LocationCourse=A has duplicate 'Alpha' and LocationCourse=B also has duplicate 'Alpha'.
steps.expected_result: CSV contains duplicates within each Location Course.
steps.data: CSV rows: (A, Alpha), (A, Alpha), (B, Alpha), (B, Alpha)

steps.action: Upload and run the CSV import.
steps.expected_result: System flags duplicates for LocationCourse=A and LocationCourse=B separately; errors are associated with the correct rows/courses.

steps.action: Verify no classes are created that violate uniqueness within either Location Course.
steps.expected_result: No duplicate Class Names exist within either Location Course after the import attempt.

cases.title: CSV import handles large file with many classes and detects duplicates without performance-related validation gaps
cases.description: Ensure validation remains correct and complete for larger imports and still detects duplicate Class Names within a Location Course.
cases.preconditions: HQ staff user is logged in. LocationCourse=A exists. System supports importing large CSV files within allowed limits.

steps.action: Prepare a large CSV file with many unique Class Names for LocationCourse=A and include a deliberate duplicate pair near the end of the file.
steps.expected_result: CSV is large and contains at least one duplicate within LocationCourse=A.
steps.data: Example: 1000 rows for LocationCourse=A with unique names plus two rows with ClassName=DupName

steps.action: Upload and run the CSV import.
steps.expected_result: System completes validation and reports the duplicate; validation does not miss duplicates due to file size.

steps.action: Review import results to ensure errors reference the correct rows and no invalid duplicates are created.
steps.expected_result: Duplicate error is present and correctly mapped; data integrity is preserved.
